# Carnival & Bratsnacht - New glowing masks 2026

![Fastnacht & Bratsnacht - New glowing masks 2026](/uploads/18_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

**Current dates:**

Last known date: Fri, August 7th, 2026 (6:00 p.m.) - Tue, August 11th, 2026 (6:00 p.m.) 4 days ago Bratsnacht weekend

## Carnival event process

The carnival event takes place once **on the hour** in **Helvetia**.

In Helvetia the **master of ceremonies on the bridge** is waiting for you. To start the event, speak to him. As soon as the event starts, you have the task of helping the participants of the carnival parade with the preparations. The participants are different at each event and are spread across Helvetia. There are the following participants and tasks:

- **Cheerful candle puller**
Collect beeswax
- **Rejoicing Decorator**
Help him choose the right decorations in the barn
- **Happy Baker**
Collect toad eggs
- **Lively musician**
Make music with the musician
- **Sociable Librarian**
Collect carnival beer mugs
- **Exuberant forest worker**
Collect 50 wood
- **Happy Butcher**
Collect squirrel guts
- **Cheerful beekeeper**
Defeat honey beasts

After the preparations have been completed, all robots or carnival participants gather at the church at the start of the parade.

As soon as everyone has arrived, we head towards the bridge. There comes the first **attack** from **RAD toads**. As soon as this attack has been repelled, go over the small bridge towards Honighaus and past it into the meadow. There is a 2nd **attack** from **super mutants**. Your job is to make sure that **the robots reach the finish line**.  If the robots suffer greatly from the attacks, you can use the perk card "**Cheer on**" under Charisma and a weapon with a flame mod, e.g. A flamethrower, a kebab knife or a "medic's" weapon can heal the bots back to full health.

After the second attack has been overcome, we head back towards the church. There is a jeep there that can explode. You should destroy it before the robots run past it. On the street towards the church there is another attack, for example. from wolves or stingers. This attack also spawns a Legendary Mega Sloth (or Ogua, Sheepsquatch, Behemoth, Blue Devil, or Grafton Monster).

At the end, the carnival fire is lit and the event is over. You can only get a rare reward from the legendary enemy at the end, not from the event.

## Donation box

There is now a donation box next to the carnival fire at the church. There you can leave your unwanted carnival hats, sun masks and other things for other players.

![Fasnacht donation box at the campfire](/uploads/nukaknights-post-fasnacht-donationbox-20240428104434-1.jpg) 

## New: Bratsnacht

What exactly is Bratsnacht? Well, Bratsnacht is a variant of the carnival event that involves bratwurst. Bratsnacht is expected to be active for some time during the Carnival event. The Brat Boy masks can only drop during Bratsnacht, not during the rest of the carnival period.

Bratsnacht will be from August 7th. take place until August 11, 2026.

## Rewards

| Crown cap | 150 | 150 | 150 |

| Legendary Items 1-3* | 2 | 2 | 2 | 
| Legendary Modules | 3-5 | 3-5 | 3-5 | 
| Stimpak <= Level 55 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 
| Standard Rewards | 100% | 100% | 100% | 
| **Rare Masks (Boss only)** | 5% | **50%** | 5% | 
| Ordinary masks | 23.75% | 12.50% | 23.75% | 
| Unusual masks | 71.25% | 37.50% | 71.25% | 
| Construction plans | 100% | 100% | 100% | 

### Standard rewards

**Important note:** All masks only drop from the boss at the end of the Carnival event. No more about the event itself.
